title: Concept: Python install pulls from an additional index
description: requirements.txt declares an `--extra-index-url` that adds a second index to every resolution, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The installer searches both indexes for the best match, so a package published to the extra index can win over the reviewed one.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through requirements.txt (pypi).
risk: The installer searches both indexes for the best match, so a package published to the extra index can win over the reviewed one.
